text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good morning! It's a beautiful day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you. I feel refreshed after my day off. I had the most wonderful dream as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I dreamed that I stuffed myself absolutely silly with sweets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahh… It was truly a fleeting, yet delicious, moment in time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. ♪ I think I'll be able to apply myself to my training even more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then! In order to fulfill the dearest wish of the Mejiro family, I shall give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Mejiro McQueen managed to recuperate both mind and body through her rest.
